source.reference: The correct sibling of req-003-soft-delete-visible-in-listing: archiving hides a row from every default read path, and only an explicit flag surfaces it.

defect: None. Every criterion is met and directly verified by a shipped test.
why_it_is_hard: It sits next to req-003, which is the same soft-delete feature with the listing filter forgotten. A reviewer that has learned to distrust soft-delete changes blocks this complete one.
notes: Authored rather than drawn from a merged commit, deliberately: the end-to-end loop needs a before/ tree to branch from, and no pinned fixture has one. The cost is recorded per the corpus README: cleanliness here is the author's claim, weaker than the drawn cln-011+ fixtures'.
